description: Reusable React components for data formatting and display in the AgentField application, including duration, timestamp, file size, execution ID, data size comparison, agent capability summary, percentage, metrics, search text highlighting, and status health indicators.

methods.name: DurationDisplay
methods.description: Component to display formatted duration from milliseconds.

methods.name: TimestampDisplay
methods.description: Component to display formatted timestamp with relative, absolute, or smart format.

methods.name: FileSizeDisplay
methods.description: Component to display formatted file size from bytes.

methods.name: ExecutionIdDisplay
methods.description: Component to display execution ID with optional copy button and truncation.

methods.name: DataSizeComparison
methods.description: Component to compare input and output data sizes.

methods.name: AgentCapabilitySummary
methods.description: Component to summarize agent reasoners and skills.

methods.name: PercentageDisplay
methods.description: Component to display a percentage value.

methods.name: MetricDisplay
methods.description: Component to display labeled metrics with optional icon and formatting.

methods.name: highlightSearchText
methods.description: Utility to highlight search query matches within text.

methods.name: StatusHealthDisplay
methods.description: Component to display status with health percentage indicator.
